name: lumnd/plato-workerman
description: Workerman server adapter for PlatoPHP: the event loop, protocol and worker processes behind plato\server\driver

suggest.ext-event: libevent based event loop. Without it Workerman falls back to select(), which is fine below a thousand connections per worker and a bottleneck above it
suggest.ext-pcntl: Required by Workerman for the master process, worker forking and signal handling
suggest.ext-posix: Required by Workerman to drop privileges and to check whether a master process is alive

repositories.comment: The framework is not on Packagist yet, so it is resolved from its own repository, whose tags carry the versions this constraint is matched against. Composer only reads the repositories of the root package, so an application installing this adapter never sees it. This entry goes away once lumnd/platophp is on Packagist.
